report:
Liver, transjugular biopsy

Sections show three fragmented cores of liver measuring 12 mm in aggregate length, with 11 portal tracts. The portal tracts contain a mild lymphocytic infiltrate with mild interface hepatitis. There is mild lobular hepatitis. Ground-glass hepatocytes are seen. METAVIR components: piecemeal necrosis 1 and lobular necrosis 1. Reticulin stain shows portal fibrosis with rare septa. HBsAg immunostain shows cytoplasmic staining of hepatocytes. HBcAg immunostain is negative.

LIVER, transjugular biopsy - CHRONIC HEPATITIS B with MILD ACTIVITY and PORTAL FIBROSIS with RARE SEPTA (METAVIR A1 F2)
